children: Ram Naim, owner and manager of Mayers Ventures LLC, disclosed a 4.86% stake in Tessera Defense and Homeland Security Inc. He filed the Schedule 13D on Sep. 17, 2026, after receiving 130,000 shares on Sep. 16, 2026 as consideration for selling part of M.E.A. Testing Systems Ltd. to the company. The deal also provides rights to 65,000 additional shares once NYSE American authorizes the issuance, suggesting a potential increase in his position.
Naim holds the shares for investment purposes and retains the right to receive 65,000 more shares upon exchange approval. He and Mayers Ventures may buy more shares or sell some holdings over time.

They also plan to speak with Tessera Defense and Homeland Security Inc.’s management, board, or other shareholders about the company’s business, strategy, and governance. As the filing notes, they "may also engage in discussions with the Issuer's management, board of directors, or other stockholders" regarding future direction.

Mayers Ventures LLC, led by Ram Naim, identifies and invests in technology companies. Naim is an Israeli citizen and oversees the firm’s investment decisions. The firm focuses on strategic stakes that can support growth initiatives and partnerships in tech-driven businesses.
